name: Honest Basics

prices.note: Men's collection T-shirts (flannel shirt excluded): Basic T-shirt €14.90 (70% organic, 30% recycled cotton, 180 gsm, preshrunk), Hipster Shirt €16.90–19.90, OG Shirt €19.90–24.90, OG Long €22.90–27.90, Long Henley €27.90. No markdowns on these. USD at ECB 2026-10-28 (1.1133).

notes: honestbasics.com serves a parked-domain redirect ('/lander'); the store is honest-basics.com (EUR). Its full catalog (62 products, one page) has product types Jeans, Joggers, Knits, Socks, Sweaters, T-Shirts, Tops, Underwear and Gift Cards: no dresses (2026-10-29).

Shipping (https://honest-basics.com/policies/shipping-policy): prices in EUR; US and Canada on the worldwide tier, €15 up to 1 kg, €25 up to 2 kg, €30 up to 3 kg, 3–6 weeks, no free-shipping threshold; UK €8.90, free over €150. Duties outside the EU may apply.
Returns: up to 30 days after receipt; customer pays return postage.
About: based in Berlin; header 'Sustainable basics for friendly prices'; mission 'to make fair fashion easy and accessible for everyone'.
